data.name: LabelDesktop
data.comment: The computer EVE Console is running on. Its name can be edited beside this label.

data.name: TogglePlacement
data.value: Place clients and show panels on this desktop

data.name: TipPlacement
data.value: Off, your game clients are left alone. EVE Console only ever sets a client's size and position, and raises it when you click a panel or another client on its monitor. It never gives a client input or focus.

data.name: TipApply
data.value: Moves clients and panels to match what is set here, on this desktop only. This also puts back clients that were moved by hand.

data.name: PendingSome
data.value: Changes to apply on monitors: {0}. Nothing moves until you press Apply.
data.comment: {0} is a list of monitor numbers.

data.name: StatusApplied
data.comment: {0} is a list of monitor numbers.

data.name: StatusLayoutInUse
data.value: A monitor is using this layout, so it can't be deleted.

data.name: StatusFailed
data.comment: {0} is the error message.

data.name: MonitorLabel
data.comment: {0} is the monitor's number, {1} and {2} its width and height in pixels.

data.name: MonitorPrimary
data.comment: {0} is the monitor's label. Primary is Windows' main display.

data.name: PanelStartWithEve
data.value: When EVE starts on this monitor

data.name: FullMonitor
data.value: Use the full monitor, including where the taskbar is

data.name: ProfileFirstName
data.comment: The name of a desktop's first profile.

data.name: ProfileInUse
data.comment: {0} is the name of the desktop profile last applied.

data.name: TipProfile
data.value: Which set of layouts and characters this tab shows and edits. Press Apply to switch to it.

data.name: StatusLastProfile
data.value: A desktop needs at least one profile, so this one can't be deleted.

data.name: MumbleModeLine
data.value: One line, listing who talks beside it

data.name: MumbleModeList
data.value: A list of the channel, talkers at the top

data.name: MumbleChooseServer
data.value: Choose a Mumble server for this control in Client Layouts.

data.name: MumbleNoServer
data.value: This Mumble server is no longer defined.

data.name: MumbleServerState
data.comment: {0} is a Mumble server's name, {1} its state, such as connecting.

data.name: WorklistNoClient
data.value: No one is logged in on this monitor.

data.name: WorklistNotInApp
data.value: {0} isn't a character in EVE Console.

data.name: WorklistNoClientShort
data.comment: A Worklist control's single line when no game client is logged in on its monitor.

data.name: WorklistModeLine
data.value: One line of counts, the list dropping down when clicked

data.name: ItemMenu
data.comment: A control on a panel: three lines that open a menu of the app's tools.

data.name: ItemToolContainer
data.comment: A control on a panel that holds one of the app's tools, or tabs of them.

data.name: MenuTargetContainer
data.comment: {0} is a layout's name, {1} a Tool Container's name in it.

data.name: MenuTargetGone
data.value: A Tool Container no longer in any layout

data.name: LabelContainerName
data.comment: A Tool Container's name, which menus show when choosing where tools open.

data.name: ContainerToolCanClose
data.comment: A tab that can't be closed also stays in its container, as the Overview stays in the main window.

data.name: LabelToolSettings
data.comment: {0} is a tool's name, picked in a Tool Container's list of starting tools.

data.name: LabelOverviewLayout
data.comment: Which of the Overview's saved layouts an Overview in this container opens with.

data.name: ToolNoSettings
data.value: Nothing to set for this tool.

data.name: ContainerNote
data.value: A tab that can't be closed stays in this container. A tool open somewhere else moves here when the container shows. An Overview here is one of its own: the main window's stays where it is.

data.name: ResetColor
data.comment: Sets a panel's color back to the default, which matches the game's UI.

data.name: StyleFlat
data.comment: A panel's edge: no depth.

data.name: StyleRaised
data.comment: A panel's edge: stands out from the screen.

data.name: StyleInset
data.comment: A panel's edge: sits into the screen.

data.name: StyleRidge
data.comment: A panel's edge: a raised line around the panel.

data.name: MenuDockBeside
data.value: Dock a panel beside this one

data.name: MenuEdgeFull
data.comment: Docked to fill all the space, so it has no size of its own.

data.name: MenuParent
data.comment: Right-click submenu for what holds the thing clicked. {0} is a panel's name, or one of the words below.

data.name: ItemLocalTimeShort
data.comment: Label right beside the local time on a panel, like "EVE" beside the EVE clock. Keep it very short.

data.name: NoCells
data.value: This layout has no client positions.

data.name: NoticeAClient
data.comment: Used in place of a character's name while a game client is at the login screen.

data.name: NoticeNotFixed
data.value: {0} isn't in Fixed Window mode, so it was left alone. Change its window mode in the game's settings.
data.comment: {0} is a character's name or "A client".

data.name: NoticeInUse
data.value: {0}: its position is in use by another logged-in character, so it stayed where it is.
data.comment: {0} is a character's name.

data.name: NoticeNoPosition
data.value: {0} is logged in but isn't in any group. Add it to a client position.
data.comment: {0} is a character's name.

data.name: NoticeMovedByHand
data.value: {0} was moved by hand, so it is left alone until you press Apply.
data.comment: {0} is a character's name or "A client".

data.name: NoticeDidNotHold
data.value: {0} didn't stay where it was placed, so it is left alone until you press Apply.
data.comment: {0} is a character's name or "A client".

data.name: OtherDesktopsNote
data.value: After reinstalling Windows, this computer looks like a new desktop. Take over its old entry to keep its monitors and groups. This replaces what is set for this desktop.

data.name: TakeOverConfirm
data.value: Click again to replace this desktop

data.name: CopyOfName
data.comment: {0} is the name of the layout that was duplicated.

data.name: LayoutHint
data.value: Right click anything to dock a panel or control in it, split it into a grid, or reach what holds it. Drag the lines between things to resize them.

data.name: LabelPreviewOn
data.comment: Which monitor's size the layout is drawn at while editing.

data.name: CanvasClient
data.comment: {0} is the number of a game client position on a monitor.

data.name: CanvasSize
data.comment: A width and height, or columns and rows of a grid.

data.name: MenuSendToBack
data.comment: Makes this panel first in dock order, so it takes its full edge.

data.name: MenuBringToFront
data.comment: Makes this panel last in dock order, so it fits in what the others leave.

data.name: WarnSmall
data.value: {0}: client {1} is only {2} × {3}, small for playing.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor's label, {1} a client position's number, {2} and {3} its width and height.

data.name: WarnNoFit
data.value: {0}: the panels here don't fit, so something has no room.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor's label.

data.name: WarnBroken
data.value: {0}: part of this layout can't be used as saved. It may have come from a newer version.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor's label.
